name: api-endpoints
title: API endpoints
description: Every endpoint of an API at a glance, grouped by resource: the method as a word, the path with parameters dimmed, a one-line job and a link to the reference.
docs: Pass groups (a label and its endpoints, each with a method, a path, a one-line description and an href), plus baseUrl for the copy field over the list and docsHref for the link beside the heading. The method is always a word in a fixed-width label: GET is quiet and outlined, POST is solid, PATCH and PUT are a strong outline and DELETE a strong dashed one, so nothing depends on colour. Parameters written as {id} or :id are dimmed in the path. Chips filter by method, show how many endpoints each holds, and a polite status says how many are on screen; a method nothing uses is never offered. Use defaultMethod to start on a chip, or method and onMethodChange to control it. On a wide block a row is four columns; on a narrow one it stacks as method and path, then the description and the link. A base URL too long for its line wraps under its button instead of hiding behind a scrollbar. Words are translated through labels.
